text: Constantly relax the pelvic floor. Chronic tensions in the pelvic area, and especially the pelvic floor, indicate attempts to keep life under control, to freeze in defense, fear of shame. Allow the pelvic area to breathe, move, be alive. Watch the state of this area in various life situations—a friend’s call, a conversation with parents or a child, a conflict at work... Your body constantly reacts, giving you clear signals about energy blocks. Relax the blocks as soon as you notice them. Not able to relax? Use yoga techniques—asanas and pranayama...
